rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual address for a male friend or acquaintance, especially when saying “dude” or “bro.”

example.jyutping: hing1 dai6 dang2 dang2 ngo5 aa3

rows.note: Use this for a friendly, somewhat familiar form of address when “dude” is not specifically male.

example.jyutping: lou5 jau5 nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when “dude” means a young man being described rather than addressed.

example.english: That young dude always helps old ladies carry things.
example.traditional: 嗰個後生仔成日幫阿婆拎嘢。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 bong1 aa3 po4 ling1 je5
